task: Complete and verify the Amosclaud Word Book runtime integration.
why: The Book must become the shared human/agent preparation and change-reporting system before later direct Amosclaud connectivity.
acceptance: Book runtime reads the repository-native manifest, chapters, capabilities and change ledger.
Book API exposes status, chapters, capabilities, changes, next task and agent context.
Human chapter completion can be recorded separately from engineering verification.
Agent snapshots identify the Book version they consumed.
Change gate rejects completion eligibility when a meaningful code change has no Book report/update.
Automated tests execute and verification evidence is recorded truthfully.
